Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Account Continuity & Reset Warning Gateway: Reorder sign-in screen messaging to emphasize existing account recovery and clear pet restoration options. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, creating confusion during login.)
1: [home, redesign] Desktop Visibility Diagnostic & Render Test Stage: Redesign the waiting screen into a stage layout featuring live rendering diagnostics and a manual visibility check button. (why: 3 support emails reported pets failing to appear on desktop or app not opening, while waiting step mean time is 2336s.)
2: [choose_path, copy] Creation Path Time Expectation Copy: Add explicit setup time estimates for Express Preset (30s) versus Custom Companion (3m) on path selection. (why: choose_path has a high mean time of 514s and 82.9% conversion, suggesting hesitation over path requirements.)
3: [adoption, wait_info] Adoption Certificate Name Display Guidance: Provide real-time guidance on how pet names will appear on desktop tooltips and companion interaction tags. (why: Adoption step mean completion time takes 1017s with 80% conversion.)
4: [home, notification] Background Desktop Render Ready Notification: Enable desktop notification alert switches during waiting stage so users know when background generation completes. (why: Waiting stage mean time is 2336s, showing users leave the app running in background while pet processes.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Interactive Story Preview Split View: Switch the story intro screen to a split layout highlighting pet behavior previews side by side. (why: The choose_path/story step exhibits long decision times (mean 514s), indicating users want clearer visual context.)
